OpenAI Revenue Chief Departs Amid Executive Shake-up

OpenAI's Chief Revenue Officer, who served less than a year, has departed the company. This marks the second significant executive departure from the AI firm in a short period. The company is also reportedly grappling with questions about the return on investment for its corporate customers using ChatGPT, according to recent research.
